description: Authored accessibility fixtures for the diligent-assess browser checks (WO-G section 3, F2). Each entry names the state the check must record for that check_id. viewports and modes tell the bless example which extra captures to record.

cases.note: Content wraps and the image scales down; no horizontal overflow at 320.
The only culprit is a plain div, not a reflow exception candidate.
Every culprit is a data table with headers, a two-dimensional layout exception candidate.
Regression: the image is wider than 320 but its overflow is contained, so the document does not scroll.
No viewports key, so only the 1280 snapshot exists and the check cannot run.
Undersized and the 24px circle reaches the neighbouring box. Deviation: the work order says 4px apart, but 4px apart does not intersect the circle (see fixture notes).
Undersized, but the spacing exception applies with 24px clearance.
Regression: 4px apart is the work order's fail case, but the 24px circle does not reach the neighbouring box (10 + 4 > 12), so the spacing exception holds.
Inline exemption: the only target is a link inside a sentence.
Meets the minimum size.
Width 23 is undersized and the touching neighbour is inside the 24px circle. Deviation: a lone 23x24 button would pass by spacing, so a touching neighbour is added.
Regression: undersized but no other target nearby, so the spacing exception holds.
The 20px link is undersized and touches the 24px link, but both share one href, so an equivalent control exists.
The focused link lies entirely inside the fixed header's box.
The fixed header covers the top 10px of the 20px link.
A sticky header exists but sits above the link in normal flow, so it never intersects the focused box.
Deviation: the work order lists this as pass, but section 4 item 13 gives not_tested when no fixed or sticky element exists (see fixture notes).
Border #a3a3a3 on white is about 2.5:1 and the background matches the page.
Border #949494 on white is about 3.03:1.
The control fill differs from the page by about 3:1, so the weak border does not matter.
Deviation: the work order names hsl(), but Chrome serialises hsl() as rgb() in computed style. oklch() is kept as written, so the colour is unparseable.
Regression: Chrome computes hsl(0 0% 50%) as rgb(128,128,128), about 3.95:1, so it parses and passes.
A background-image on an ancestor makes the backdrop unresolvable.
Disabled controls are exempt.
Fixed height with overflow hidden; the text grows past the box under the spacing overrides. The paragraph with a non-important style attribute supplies the pass row for part one.
Same box with overflow auto: text is reachable by scrolling, so nothing is clipped.
!important at 0.05em is below 0.12em.
Regression: every !important value is exactly at the metric, which meets it.
Without !important the user can override, so the style passes.
Regression: a CSS-wide keyword with !important does not lock spacing.
No style attributes and no text-spacing snapshot.
A background-image makes the effective background unresolvable.
Composites to #333 on white, about 12.6:1.
Ancestor opacity below 1 makes the result unresolvable.
18.66px bold is below 14pt (18.666px), so normal text needs 4.5:1 and #929292 on white is about 3.1:1.
Large text needs 3:1 and #929292 on white is about 3.1:1.
Regression: #767676 on white is about 4.54:1.
Computed style keeps oklch(), which parse_css_color does not read.
No text nodes with content.
Tab walks the links and returns to the start.
A focusout handler returns focus to the group's first link, so Tab lands on an earlier stop other than the first (RepeatOf). Timing sensitive.
